Stalk $GDX via $NUGT 2x Long (Bullish Flag)

Broke out yesterday when highlighted as Stalk but today's pre-market is pointing towards a gap down back into bullish flag pattern. Will need at least 2 tight days from here before Focus

Stalk $EROC (New IPO, PEG Delayed Reaction)

Has an ascending base from July 29th low, that's prior to the PEG. PEG gap up to T+3 before fading off back to another higher low. Has attempted to break $13.90 range on 2 separate occasion while maintaining the higher low ascending base. Last print is too wide to focus now and it still has room to tighten into the apex of the triangle.

Stalk $ZETA (Sideway Box Range)

Gap up open yesterday but on low volume and just traded straight down from open without ORH attempt. Remains a stalk at the moment as it trades back into sideway box range on 10 and 20-MA. Only 2.4 x ATR% from 50-MA but range is too wide to Focus.

Not a bad thing to stay on the sideline for $XLK names as it has been strongly up for 4 days in a row.

Stalk $NTAP (Base on Base, Attempting All Time High)

$NTAP has not moved much from last 2 PEG of Q1 +26% EPS +12% Sales, Q2 +66% EPS +30% Sales YoY but morphed into a 4-month base on base pattern with $200 as key low cheat level to focus for breakout ahead of $207 all time high. Prints have 3 days of intraday decline but remains above all MA. I want to see at least 2 days tighten range of first higher low from here before Focus

Stalk $FROG (PEG Delayed Reaction)

Hasn't play out its +50% EPS +29% Sales YoY from August 7th PEG. Price is now back to PEG day range but has 3 consecutive days of lower highs. Needs to build and tighten here. If you look at the weekly, it's actually a 6-year old IPO U-Base pattern from 2020 September. Let it consolidate to reclaim and push beyond the all time high.

Stalk $MGNI (PEG Delayed Reaction)

Thought we may have missed this idea without ORH but the gap up has faded for 3 consecutive session. This is still a stalk worthy idea as long as it re-base back into PEG range above the rising 10 and 20-MA.

Stalk $WDAY (Box Range within PEG)

Still in my stalk but if price break and closed strongly below the highlighted box range, i will be removing this idea.

Stalk $AMZN via $AMZU 2x Long (Bullish Flag but sluggish)

Strength in $MAGS didn't propel $AMZN, but it has been 4 consecutive days of higher low that traded out of all MAs and the weekly flag range. Weekly price prints have reflected very clear reduced rate of change within flag pattern and this move out of flag may just be the beginning of a multi week increasing ROC price prints from here.

Still a stalk for further sideway prints below $260.

Stalk $NOK (Bullish Ascending Triangle)

This is classic trend reversal Bullish Ascending Triangle technical chart pattern. If it's gonna break $11 any time soon, it needs as high as 50% RVOL to get me in on ORH within 30mins. At the current juncture of 4th up days in a row for $QQQ, i don't think the odds of grinding out a big win from this is high.

It looks much more settled as the frontrunner for the next rally leg swing. Coincidentally, there's still room to sideway and build further into the apex of the triangle

Focus $SNOW (PEG Delayed Reaction)

This still hasn't triggered a M30 ORH. Has an higher low even on the intraday red print, above all MAs, and within a 4 day upper box range. Don't need RVOL but hold off the first 30mins first to avoid trap, similar to yesterday.

Stalk $MSFT via $MSFU (Still in Triangle Range)

Didn't ORH from the gap up open on yesterday's Focus for execution, and price close back into triangle range. Now pre-market has a gap up print but we need at least 2 more tightened prints before Focus. Let it print

Your Homework

$FTNT (All Time High under 3 x ATR% from 50-MA)

This is probably a stronger cybersecurity idea than $SNOW considering that it has been poking the all time high level consistently for the last 5 out of 6 sessions. When I look at how the stock price prints and behave when it reached multiple 10 x ATR% from 50-MA in Late May and Early June, it is quite clear that the stock will be sluggish going from then.

At this point, we know a new all-time high looks imminent. But can the stock sustain the move and transition into a true momentum expansion run from here? Have you seen a stock do that before?

Weekly Chart of
$FTNT

Stalk $ESTC (PEG Delayed Reaction)

A small gap down resistance to fill before Focus.

Focus $INFQ (Pre-Market Gapper)

Gapping out of base at pre-market but share volume is only 480k done now. Avg share vol is 9.3mil. I am looking at execution based on 30% RVOL within 30mins of open within <70% of LoD

Stalk $HNGE (Out of Box Range)

Still couldn't find an entry into this but $HNGE is already out of the highlighted sideway box range from Sept 14th move. 6 days on still no follow through but it hasn't revisited the low of Sept 14th print. 3 sessions of lower high but last one has rebounded off rising 20-MA.

Action is still very sluggish but last 3 print is considerable tight at only 65% of ATR. I prefer at least some higher low sideway action before Focus

Stalk $U (2nd higher low below $44)

Would prefer another tightened print, unless it does a RVOL breakout of $44 exceeding 20% RVOL within 30mins

Focus $CRSR (Still waiting for a high RVOL based move)

I am still tracking $CRSR for a high RVOL based entry. Stock is drifting higher within trend channel but if you study the prints day by day, you can easily get stop out before T+4. Look at how non-existent those volume prints are. A high RVOL based move similar to May 22nd is the only way to ignite this stock to 10 x ATR% from 50-MA in the shortest possible duration (it took only 3 days back then).

Focus $QUBT (Pre-Market Gapper)

Among the liquid quantum names gapping up at pre-market, $QUBT is the only one will open above it's declining 200-MA. pre-market share vol is only 920k now. I'm looking for 30% RVOL within 30mins for execution.

but I wouldn't be surprise to see it deflate and drift lower from open
